criteria.requirement: Add pyparsing.recovery.parse_recovering(expression,text,separator=";",quote="\"",escape="\\") with immutable RecoveryResult, AcceptedRecord and RejectedRecord. Split only at explicit single-character separators outside quoted/escaped text, including multiline records. Parse each nonblank record completely using real grammar; retain successful ParseResults plus original absolute start/end and ordered failures with original ParseException and absolute offset. Skip blank records only; unclosed quoted tail remains one failed record rather than inventing internal boundaries. Propagate ParseFatalException and ordinary action exceptions, explicitly do not roll back action side effects. Preserve strict default parse_string and original keepTabs.
